9.1.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
9.1.text: The Bhagavat said, "To you, who are entertaining no displeasure, I shall clearly declare this most secret knowledge, together with action, by knowing which you shall be free from evil."

9.1.author: Swami Adidevananda
9.1.text: The Lord said, "I shall declare to you, who does not cavil, this most mysterious knowledge, together with its special knowledge, knowing which you will be freed from evil."

9.1.author: Swami Gambirananda
9.1.text: The Blessed Lord said: However, to you who are not given to cavilling, I shall speak of this highest secret itself, which is knowledge combined with experience, by realizing which you shall be free from evil.

9.1.author: Swami Sivananda
9.1.text: The Blessed Lord said, "I shall now declare to thee, who does not cavil, the greatest secret—the knowledge combined with experience (Self-realisation). Having known this, thou shalt be free from evil."

9.1.author: Shri Purohit Swami
9.1.text: Lord Shri Krishna said: I will now reveal to you, since you do not doubt, that profound mysticism, which, when followed with experience, will liberate you from sin.

9.2.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
9.2.text: This shines among the sciences; it is the secret of monarchs; it is a supreme purifier, comprehensible by immediate perception, righteous, easy to do, and imperishable.

9.2.author: Swami Adidevananda
9.2.text: This is the royal science, the royal mystery, the supreme purifier. It is realized through direct experience, is in accord with Dharma, is pleasant to practice, and is abiding.

9.2.author: Swami Gambirananda
9.2.text: This is the sovereign knowledge, the sovereign profundity, the best sanctifier; directly realizable, righteous, very easy to practice, and imperishable.

9.2.author: Swami Sivananda
9.2.text: This is the royal science, the royal secret, the supreme purifier, realizable by direct intuitive knowledge, according to righteousness, very easy to perform and imperishable.

9.2.author: Shri Purohit Swami
9.2.text: This is the supreme science, the supreme secret, the purest and best; it is intuitive, righteous, and to those who practice it, it is exceedingly pleasant.

9.3.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
9.3.text: O scorcher of foes! Those who have no faith in this Dharma do not attain Me and remain eternally in the cycle of mundane existence, fraught with death.

9.3.author: Swami Adidevananda
9.3.text: Men devoid of faith in this Dharma, O scorcher of foes, ever remain without attaining Me, on the mortal path of Samsara.

9.3.author: Swami Gambirananda
9.3.text: O destroyer of foes, those who are disregarding this Dharma (knowledge of the Self) certainly go round and round, without reaching Me, along the path of transmigration which is fraught with death.

9.3.author: Swami Sivananda
9.3.text: Those who have no faith in this Dharma, O Parantapa, return to the path of this world without attaining Me.

9.3.author: Shri Purohit Swami
9.3.text: They who have no faith in this teaching cannot find Me; they remain lost in the purlieus of this perishable world.

9.4.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
9.4.text: This entire universe is pervaded by Me, having an unmanifest form; all beings exist in Me, and I do not exist in them.

9.4.author: Swami Adidevananda
9.4.text: This entire universe is pervaded by Me, in an unmanifest form. All beings abide in Me, but I do not abide in them.

9.4.author: Swami Gambirananda
9.4.text: This whole world is pervaded by Me in My unmanifest form. All beings exist in Me, but I am not contained within them!

9.4.author: Swami Sivananda
9.4.text: All of this world is pervaded by Me in My unmanifest aspect; all beings exist within Me, but I do not dwell within them.

9.4.author: Shri Purohit Swami
9.4.text: The whole world is pervaded by Me, yet My form is not visible. All living beings have their being in Me, yet I am not confined by them.

9.5.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
9.5.text: Yet, the beings do not exist in Me. Look at My Sovereign Yoga. My Self is the sustainer of the beings; it does not exist in them, and causes them to be born.

9.5.author: Swami Adidevananda
9.5.text: Yet, beings do not remain in Me. Behold My divine Yoga. I am the sustainer of all beings, yet I am not in them. It is My will alone that causes their existence.

9.5.author: Swami Gambirananda
9.5.text: Neither do the beings dwell in Me. Behold My divine Yoga! I am the sustainer and originator of beings, but My Self is not contained within the beings.

9.5.author: Swami Sivananda
9.5.text: Nor do beings exist in Me (in reality); behold, My divine Yoga, which supports all beings, but does not dwell in them, is My Self, the efficient cause of beings.

9.5.author: Shri Purohit Swami
9.5.text: Nevertheless, they do not consciously abide in Me. Such is My Divine Sovereignty that, though I, the Supreme Self, am the cause and upholder of all, yet I remain outside.

9.6.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
9.6.text: Just as the mighty wind exists in the ether, always moving therein everywhere, in the same manner all beings exist in Me. Be sure of it.

9.6.author: Swami Adidevananda
9.6.text: As the powerful element air, moving everywhere, ever remains in the ether, know that so too all beings abide in Me.

9.6.author: Swami Gambirananda
9.6.text: Understand thus that just as the voluminous wind, moving everywhere, is ever present in space, similarly all beings abide in Me.

9.6.author: Swami Sivananda
9.6.text: As the mighty wind, moving everywhere, always rests in the ether, so too, know that all beings rest in Me.

9.6.author: Shri Purohit Swami
9.6.text: As the mighty wind, though moving everywhere, has no resting place except in space, so all these beings have no home except in Me.

9.7.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
9.7.text: O son of Kunti, all beings pass into My nature at the end of the Kalpa (the age of universe); I send them forth again at the beginning of the [next] Kalpa.

9.7.author: Swami Adidevananda
9.7.text: All beings, O Arjuna, enter into My Prakriti at the end of a cycle of time; again, I send them forth at the beginning of a cycle of time.

9.7.author: Swami Gambirananda
9.7.text: O son of Kunti, all the beings at the end of a cycle go back to My Prakrti. At the beginning of a cycle, I project them forth again.

9.7.author: Swami Sivananda
9.7.text: All beings, O Arjuna, go into My Nature at the end of a Kalpa; I send them forth again at the beginning of the next Kalpa.

9.7.author: Shri Purohit Swami
9.7.text: All beings, O Arjuna, return at the end of every cosmic cycle into the realm of Nature, which is a part of Me, and at the start of the next I send them forth again.

9.8.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
9.8.text: Taking hold of My own nature, I again and again send forth this entire host of beings, which is powerless under the control of My nature.

9.8.author: Swami Adidevananda
9.8.text: Controlling the Prakṛti, which is My own, I send forth again and again this multitude of beings, helpless under the sway of Prakṛti.

9.8.author: Swami Gambirananda
9.8.text: Keeping My own prakṛti under control, I project forth again and again this multitude of beings, which are powerless due to the influence of their own nature.

9.8.author: Swami Sivananda
9.8.text: Animating My Nature, I again and again send forth all this multitude of beings, helpless under the force of Nature.

9.8.author: Shri Purohit Swami
9.8.text: With the help of Nature, I again and again pour forth the whole multitude of beings, whether they will or not, for they are ruled by My will.

9.9.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
9.9.text: O Dhananjaya! These acts do not bind me, remaining as if unconcerned and unattached in these actions.

9.9.author: Swami Adidevananda
9.9.text: But these actions do not bind Me, O Arjuna, for I remain detached from them, as if I were unconcerned.

9.9.author: Swami Gambirananda
9.9.text: O Dhananjaya, those actions do not bind Me, for I remain unconcerned and unattached to them.

9.9.author: Swami Sivananda
9.9.text: These acts do not bind Me, O Arjuna, sitting as one indifferent, unattached to those acts.

9.9.author: Shri Purohit Swami
9.9.text: But these acts of mine do not bind me; I remain outside and unattached.

9.10.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
9.10.text: O son of Kunti! On account of Me, who remain only as an observer and the prime cause, My nature gives birth to both the moving and the unmoving; hence, this world moves in a circle.

9.10.author: Swami Adidevananda
9.10.text: Under My supervision, Prakrti gives birth to all mobile and immobile entities, and thus, O Arjuna, the world revolves.

9.10.author: Swami Gambirananda
9.10.text: Under Me as the supervisor, the Prakrti produces the world of the moving and the non-moving things. Owing to this, O son of Kunti, the world revolves.

9.10.author: Swami Sivananda
9.10.text: Under Me, as supervisor, Nature produces the moving and the unmoving; therefore, O Arjuna, the world revolves.

9.10.author: Shri Purohit Swami
9.10.text: Under my guidance, Nature produces all movable and immovable things. Thus, O Arjuna, this universe revolves.

9.11.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
9.11.text: Unaware of My immutable, highest Absolute Supreme nature, the deluded ones disregard Me, dwelling in the human body.

9.11.author: Swami Adidevananda
9.11.text: Fools disregard Me, dwelling in a human form, not knowing My higher nature as the Supreme Lord of all beings.

9.11.author: Swami Gambirananda
9.11.text: Not knowing My supreme nature as the Lord of all beings, foolish people disregard Me, who have taken a human form.

9.11.author: Swami Sivananda
9.11.text: Fools disregard Me, clad in human form, not knowing My higher Being as the great Lord of all beings.

9.11.author: Shri Purohit Swami
9.11.text: Fools disregard Me, seeing Me clad in human form. They do not know that in My higher nature, I am the Lord-God of all.

9.12.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
9.12.text: They are of futile aspirations, futile actions, futile knowledge, and wrong intellect; and they take recourse only to the delusive nature that is both demoniac and devilish.

9.12.author: Swami Adidevananda
9.12.text: Senseless people have a nature that is deluding and similar to that of rakshasas and asuras. Their hopes are futile, their actions are futile, and their knowledge is futile.

9.12.author: Swami Gambirananda
9.12.text: Possessed of vain hopes, vain actions, vain knowledge, and senselessness, they become verily possessed of the deceptive disposition of fiends and demons.

9.12.author: Swami Sivananda
9.12.text: They are possessed of the deceitful nature of demons and undivine beings, filled with vain hopes, vain actions, and vain knowledge that is senseless.

9.12.author: Shri Purohit Swami
9.12.text: Their hopes are futile, their actions worthless, their knowledge ineffective; they are without sense, deceitful, barbaric, and godless.

9.13.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
9.13.text: O son of Prtha! The great-souled men, however, taking hold of the divine nature and having nothing else in their minds, adore Me, viewing Me as the imperishable prime cause of beings.

9.13.author: Swami Adidevananda
9.13.text: But the great-souled ones, O Arjuna, who are associated with My divine nature, worship Me with an unwavering mind, knowing Me to be the immutable source of all beings.

9.13.author: Swami Gambirananda
9.13.text: O son of Prtha, the noble ones, being possessed of divine nature, surely adore Me with single-mindedness, knowing Me to be the immutable source of all objects.

9.13.author: Swami Sivananda
9.13.text: But the great souls, O Arjuna, partaking of My divine nature, worship Me with a single-minded devotion, knowing Me as the imperishable source of all beings.

9.13.author: Shri Purohit Swami
9.13.text: But the great souls, O Arjuna! Filled with my divine spirit, they worship me, fix their minds on me alone, for they know that I am the imperishable source of being.

9.14.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
9.14.text: Ever speaking of My glory, striving with firm resolve, paying homage to Me, and being permanently endowed with devotion, they worship Me.

9.14.author: Swami Adidevananda
9.14.text: Aspiring for eternal communion with Me, they worship Me, always singing My praises, striving with steadfast resolution and bowing down to Me in devotion.

9.14.author: Swami Gambirananda
9.14.text: Always glorifying Me and striving, the men of firm vows worship Me by paying obeisance to Me and being ever endowed with devotion.

9.14.author: Swami Sivananda
9.14.text: Always glorifying Me, striving, firm in their vows, prostrating themselves before Me, they worship Me with steadfast devotion.

9.14.author: Shri Purohit Swami
9.14.text: Always extolling Me, they are strenuous and firm in their vows, prostrating themselves before Me, and worshiping Me continually with concentrated devotion.

9.15.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
9.15.text: Some worship Me by knowledge-sacrifice, and others by offering sacrifices; thus, they worship Me, the Universally-Faced, either as One or as Many.

9.15.author: Swami Adidevananda
9.15.text: Others, besides offering the sacrifice of knowledge, also worship Me as One, who is characterized by diversity in countless ways and is multiform (in My Cosmic aspect).

9.15.author: Swami Gambirananda
9.15.text: Others indeed worship Me by exclusively adoring through the sacrifice of the knowledge of oneness; (others worship Me) in many ways, and (others) as the multiform existing in various forms.

9.15.author: Swami Sivananda
9.15.text: Others also, sacrificing with the wisdom-sacrifice, worship Me, the All-Faced, as one, distinct, and manifold.

9.15.author: Shri Purohit Swami
9.15.text: Others worship Me with full consciousness as the One, the Manifold, the Omnipresent, and the Universal.

9.16.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
9.16.text: I am determination; I am sacrifice; I am Svadha; I am the juice of the herb; I am the Vedic hymn; I am also the clarified butter; I am the sacrificial fire; and I am the act of offering.

9.16.author: Swami Adidevananda
9.16.text: I am Kratu, I am the sacrifice, I am the offering to the manes, I am the herb, I am the Mantra, I am the clarified butter, I am the fire, I am the oblation.

9.16.author: Swami Gambirananda
9.16.text: I am the ritual, I am the sacrifice, I am the oblation, I am the medicinal herb, I am the mantra, I am the clarified butter, I am the fire, and I am the act of offering.

9.16.author: Swami Sivananda
9.16.text: I am Kratu; I am Yajna; I am the offering to the manes; I am the medicinal herbs and all plants; I am the Mantra; I am also the ghee or melted butter; I am the fire; I am the oblation.

9.16.author: Shri Purohit Swami
9.16.text: I am the oblation, the sacrifice, and the worship; I am the fuel and the chant; I am the butter offered to the fire; I am the fire itself, and I am the act of offering.

9.17.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
9.17.text: I am the father, the mother, the sustainer, and the paternal grandparent of this world; I am the sacred object of knowledge, the syllable Om, the Rk, the Saman, and the Yajus as well.

9.17.author: Swami Adidevananda
9.17.text: I am the father, mother, creator, and grandfather of the universe; I am the purifier. I am the syllable Om, as well as Rk, Saman, and Yajus.

9.17.author: Swami Gambirananda
9.17.text: Of this world, I am the father, mother, ordainer, and grandfather; I am the knowable, the sanctifier, the syllable Om, as well as the Rk, Sama, and Yajus.

9.17.author: Swami Sivananda
9.17.text: I am the father of this world, the mother, the dispenser of the fruits of actions, and the grandfather; the one thing to be known, the purifier, the sacred monosyllable (Om), and also the Rik, Sama, and Yajur Vedas.

9.17.author: Shri Purohit Swami
9.17.text: I am the Father of the universe, its Mother, Nourisher, and Grandfather; I am the Knowable and the Pure; I am Om, and I am the Sacred Scriptures.

9.18.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
9.18.text: I am the method, the nourisher, the lord, the witness, the abode, the refuge, the good-hearted friend, the origin, the dissolution, the sustenance, the repository, and the imperishable seed of the world.

9.18.author: Swami Adidevananda
9.18.text: I am the goal, the supporter, the Lord, the witness, the abode, the refuge, and the friend. I am the origin, the dissolution, the basis for preservation, and the imperishable seed.

9.18.author: Swami Gambirananda
9.18.text: I am the fruit of actions, the nourisher, the Lord, witness, abode, refuge, friend, origin, end, foundation, store, and the imperishable seed.

9.18.author: Swami Sivananda
9.18.text: I am the goal, the supporter, the Lord, the witness, the abode, the shelter, the friend, the origin, the dissolution, the foundation, the treasure-house, and the imperishable seed.

9.18.author: Shri Purohit Swami
9.18.text: I am the goal, the sustainer, the Lord, the witness, the home, the shelter, the lover, and the origin; I am life and death; I am the fountain and the imperishable seed.

9.19.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
9.19.text: I give heat; I withhold and also send forth rains; I am immortality and also death, the real and the unreal, O Arjuna!

9.19.author: Swami Adidevananda
9.19.text: I give heat, I withhold and send forth the rain; I am immortality and also death, O Arjuna. I am the being and the non-being.

9.19.author: Swami Gambirananda
9.19.text: O Arjuna, I give heat, I withhold and pour down rain; I am verily the nectar, and also death, existence, and non-existence.

9.19.author: Swami Sivananda
9.19.text: As the sun, I give heat; I withhold and send forth the rain; I am immortality and also death, existence and non-existence, O Arjuna.

9.19.author: Shri Purohit Swami
9.19.text: I am the heat of the sun, I release and withhold the rain. I am death and immortality; I am being and non-being.

9.20.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
9.20.text: The masters of the three Vedas, the soma-drinkers, purified of their sins, aspire for the heavenly goal by offering sacrifices to Me. They attain the meritorious world of the Lord of Gods and taste in the heavens the heavenly pleasures of the gods.

9.20.author: Swami Adidevananda
9.20.text: Those who are versed in the three Vedas, having been purified from sin by drinking the Soma juice, pray for passage to heaven and worship Me through sacrifices. Reaching the holy realm of the chief of the gods, they enjoy celestial pleasures in heaven.

9.20.author: Swami Gambirananda
9.20.text: Those who are versed in the Vedas, who drink Soma and are purified of sin, pray for the heavenly goal by worshipping Me through sacrifices. Having reached the place (world) of the king of gods, which is the result of righteousness, they enjoy the divine pleasure of the gods in heaven.

9.20.author: Swami Sivananda
9.20.text: The knowers of the three Vedas, the drinkers of Soma, purified of all sins, worshipping Me through sacrifices, pray for the way to heaven; they reach the holy world of the Lord of the gods and enjoy the divine pleasures of the gods in heaven.

9.20.author: Shri Purohit Swami
9.20.text: Those who are versed in the scriptures, who drink the mystic Soma-juice and are purified from sin, and who, while worshipping Me with sacrifices, pray that I will lead them to heaven; they reach the holy world where the Controller of the Powers of Nature resides, and they enjoy the feasts of Paradise.

9.21.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
9.21.text: Having enjoyed that vast world of heaven, they, when their merit is exhausted, enter the world of mortals. Thus, those who long for pleasure and continuously take refuge in the code of conduct prescribed by the Three Vedas, attain the state of going and coming.

9.21.author: Swami Adidevananda
9.21.text: Having enjoyed the spacious world of heaven, they return to the world of mortals, their merit having been exhausted. Thus, those who follow the Vedic rituals and are drawn by desires come and go.

9.21.author: Swami Gambirananda
9.21.text: After having enjoyed that vast heavenly world, they enter into the human world upon the exhaustion of their merit. Thus, those who follow the rites and duties prescribed in the three Vedas, and are desirous of pleasures, attain the state of coming and going.

9.21.author: Swami Sivananda
9.21.text: They, having enjoyed the vast heaven, enter the world of mortals when their merit is exhausted; thus abiding by the injunctions of the three (Vedas) and desiring objects of desires, they attain to the state of coming and going.

9.21.author: Shri Purohit Swami
9.21.text: Yet, although they enjoy the spacious glories of Paradise, when their merit is exhausted, they are born again into this world of mortals. They have followed the letter of the scriptures, yet, because they have sought to fulfill their own desires, they must depart and return again and again.

9.22.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
9.22.text: Those men who, having nothing else as their goal, worship Me everywhere and are constantly thinking of Me alone; to them, who are fully and constantly attached to Me, I bear acquisition and the security of acquisition.

9.22.author: Swami Adidevananda
9.22.text: Those who, excluding all else, think of Me and worship Me, aspiring after eternal union with Me, I look after their prosperity and welfare (Yoga and Ksema).

9.22.author: Swami Gambirananda
9.22.text: Those persons who, becoming non-different from Me and meditating, worship Me everywhere, for them, who are ever attached to Me, I arrange for securing what they lack and preserving what they have.

9.22.author: Swami Sivananda
9.22.text: For those men who worship Me alone, thinking of no one else, for those ever-united, I secure what they have not already possessed and preserve what they already possess.

9.22.author: Shri Purohit Swami
9.22.text: But if a person meditates on Me and Me alone, worships Me always and everywhere, I will take upon Myself the fulfillment of their aspiration, and I will safeguard whatever they attain.

9.23.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
9.23.text: O son of Kunti! Even those who are devotees of other gods and worship them with faith, worship Me alone, but following non-injunctive practices.

9.23.author: Swami Adidevananda
9.23.text: Even those who are devoted to other divinities with faith in their hearts, worship Me alone, O Arjuna, though not in accordance with the Sastras.

9.23.author: Swami Gambirananda
9.23.text: Even those who, being devoted to other deities and endowed with faith, worship them, they also, O son of Kunti, worship Me alone, though following the wrong method.

9.23.author: Swami Sivananda
9.23.text: Even those devotees who, endowed with faith, worship other gods, worship Me alone, O Arjuna, but by the wrong method.

9.23.author: Shri Purohit Swami
9.23.text: Even those who worship the lesser powers, if they do so with faith, they are thereby worshipping Me, though not in the correct manner.

9.24.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
9.24.text: For I am the enjoyer and the Lord of all sacrifices, yet they do not recognize Me correctly and thus they turn away.

9.24.author: Swami Adidevananda
9.24.text: For, I am the only enjoyer and the only Lord of all sacrifices. They do not recognize Me in My true nature; hence, they fall.

9.24.author: Swami Gambirananda
9.24.text: Indeed, I am the enjoyer and the Lord of all sacrifices, but they do not know Me truly. Therefore, they fall.

9.24.author: Swami Sivananda
9.24.text: For I alone am the enjoyer and Lord of all sacrifices; but they do not know Me in reality, and thus they return to this mortal world.

9.24.author: Shri Purohit Swami
9.24.text: I am the willing recipient of sacrifice, and I am its true Lord. But they do not know me truly, so they fall back.

9.25.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
9.25.text: The devotees of the gods attain the gods; the devotees of the ancestors attain the ancestors; those who perform sacrifices for the spirits attain the spirits; and those who perform sacrifices for Me attain Me.

9.25.author: Swami Adidevananda
9.25.text: Devotees of gods go to the gods; manes-worshippers go to the manes; worshippers of Bhutas go to the Bhutas; and those who worship Me come to Me.

9.25.author: Swami Gambirananda
9.25.text: Those who worship the gods reach the gods; the worshippers of the manes go to the manes; the devotees of the Beings reach the Beings; and those who worship Me come to Me.

9.25.author: Swami Sivananda
9.25.text: The worshippers of the gods go to them; the ancestor-worshippers go to the manes; the worshippers of the deities who preside over the elements go to them; but My devotees come to Me.

9.25.author: Shri Purohit Swami
9.25.text: The votaries of the lesser powers go to them; the devotees of spirits go to them; they who worship the powers of darkness, to such powers shall they go; and so too, those who worship me shall come to me.

9.26.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
9.26.text: Whoever offers Me a leaf, a flower, a fruit, or even a little water with devotion, I accept that offering of devotion from one who has a well-controlled mind.

9.26.author: Swami Adidevananda
9.26.text: Whoever offers Me with true devotion a leaf, a flower, a fruit, or some water, I accept this offering made with devotion by them who are pure of heart.

9.26.author: Swami Gambirananda
9.26.text: Whoever offers Me with devotion—a leaf, a flower, a fruit, or water—I accept that gift of the pure-hearted man which has been presented devotionally.

9.26.author: Swami Sivananda
9.26.text: Whoever offers Me with devotion a leaf, a flower, a fruit, or a little water, that, so offered devotedly by the pure-minded, I accept.

9.26.author: Shri Purohit Swami
9.26.text: Whatever a person offers to Me, be it a leaf, flower, fruit, or water, I accept it, for it is offered with devotion and a pure mind.

9.27.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
9.27.text: Whatever you do, whatever you eat, whatever oblation you offer, whatever gift you make, and whatever austerity you perform, O son of Kunti, do that as an offering to Me.

9.27.author: Swami Adidevananda
9.27.text: Whatever you do, whatever you eat, whatever you offer, whatever you give away, whatever austerity you practice, O Arjuna, do that as an offering to Me.

9.27.author: Swami Gambirananda
9.27.text: O son of Kunti, whatever you do, whatever you eat, whatever you offer as a sacrifice, whatever you give, and whatever austerities you undertake—all of that you offer to Me.

9.27.author: Swami Sivananda
9.27.text: Whatever you do, whatever you eat, whatever you offer in sacrifice, whatever you give, whatever austerity you practice, O Arjuna, do it as an offering to Me.

9.27.author: Shri Purohit Swami
9.27.text: Whatever you do, whatever you eat, whatever you sacrifice and give, whatever austerities you practice, do all as an offering to Me.

9.28.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
9.28.text: Thus, you shall be freed from the good and evil results which are the action-bonds. Having your innate nature immersed in the Yoga of renunciation and, thus, being fully liberated, you shall attain Me.

9.28.author: Swami Adidevananda
9.28.text: Thus equipped in mind with the Yoga of renunciation, you will free yourself from the bonds of Karma, productive of both auspicious and inauspicious fruits. Thus liberated, you will come to Me.

9.28.author: Swami Gambirananda
9.28.text: Thus, you will become free from bondage in the form of actions which are productive of good and bad results. Having your mind imbued with the yoga of renunciation and becoming free, you will attain Me.

9.28.author: Swami Sivananda
9.28.text: Thus, you shall be freed from the bonds of actions yielding good and evil fruits; with the mind steadfast in the Yoga of renunciation, and liberated, you shall come to Me.

9.28.author: Shri Purohit Swami
9.28.text: So, your action will have no result, either good or bad; but, through the spirit of renunciation, you will come to Me and be free.

9.29.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
9.29.text: I am the same in all beings; none is hateful to Me and none is dear; but whoever worships Me with devotion, they are in Me and I am in them.

9.29.author: Swami Adidevananda
9.29.text: I am the same to all creation; there is none hateful or dear to me. But those who worship me with devotion abide in me, and I in them.

9.29.author: Swami Gambirananda
9.29.text: I am impartial towards all beings; to Me there is none detestable or none dear. But those who worship Me with devotion, they exist in Me, and I too exist in them.

9.29.author: Swami Sivananda
9.29.text: I am the same to all beings; there is none hateful or dear to Me; but those who worship Me with devotion are in Me, and I am also in them.

9.29.author: Shri Purohit Swami
9.29.text: I am the same to all beings; I do not favour any, nor do I hate any. However, those who worship Me devotedly, they live in Me and I in them.

9.30.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
9.30.text: Even if an incorrigible evil-doer worships Me, not resorting to any other [goal], he should be deemed to be righteous; for, he has properly undertaken his task.

9.30.author: Swami Adidevananda
9.30.text: If even the most sinful man worships Me with undivided devotion, he should be regarded as holy, for he has rightly resolved.

9.30.author: Swami Gambirananda
9.30.text: Even if a man of very bad conduct worships Me with single-minded devotion, he is to be considered truly good; for he has rightly resolved.

9.30.author: Swami Sivananda
9.30.text: Even if the most sinful worships Me, with devotion to no one else, he should indeed be regarded as righteous, for he has rightly resolved.

9.30.author: Shri Purohit Swami
9.30.text: Even the most sinful, if he worships Me with his whole heart, shall be considered righteous, for he is treading the right path.

9.31.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
9.31.text: Quickly he becomes righteous-minded and attains permanent peace. O son of Kunti! I swear that my devotee never gets lost.

9.31.author: Swami Adidevananda
9.31.text: Quickly, he becomes righteous and obtains everlasting peace. Affirm on My behalf, O Arjuna, that My devotee never perishes.

9.31.author: Swami Gambirananda
9.31.text: He soon becomes possessed of a virtuous mind; he attains everlasting peace. Do you proclaim boldly, O son of Kunti, that My devotee will not be ruined.

9.31.author: Swami Sivananda
9.31.text: Soon he becomes righteous and attains eternal peace; O Arjuna, proclaim thou for certain that My devotee never perishes.

9.31.author: Shri Purohit Swami
9.31.text: He will soon attain spirituality and eternal peace. O Arjuna! Believe me, my devotee is never lost.

9.32.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
9.32.text: O son of Prtha, even those who are of sinful birth, women, men of working class, and the members of the fourth caste—even they, having taken refuge in Me, attain the highest goal.

9.32.author: Swami Adidevananda
9.32.text: By taking refuge in Me, even those of evil birth, women, Vaisyas, and Sudras, attain the supreme state.

9.32.author: Swami Gambirananda
9.32.text: For, O son of Prtha, even those who are born of sin-women, Vaisyas, as well as Sudras—[S.'s construction of this portion is: women, Vaisyas as well as Sudras, and even others who are born of sin (i.e., those who are born low and are of vile deeds, viz Mlecchas, Pukkasas and others). M.S. also takes papa-yonayah (born of sin) as a separate phrase, and classifies women and others only as those darred from Vedic study, etc.-Tr.]—even they reach the highest Goal by taking shelter under Me.

9.32.author: Swami Sivananda
9.32.text: For, taking refuge in Me, they who, O Arjuna, may be of a sinful birth—women, Vaisyas, and Sudras—attain the Supreme Goal.

9.32.author: Shri Purohit Swami
9.32.text: Even the children of sinful parents, those miscalled the weaker sex, merchants, and laborers, if they make Me their refuge, they shall attain the highest.

9.33.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
9.33.text: Certainly, it should be so in the case of the pious men of the priestly class and devoted royal seers. Having come to this transient and joyless world, you should be devoted to Me.

9.33.author: Swami Adidevananda
9.33.text: How much more then, for the pure Brahmanas and royal sages who are My devotees! Having obtained this transient and joyless world, they should worship Me.

9.33.author: Swami Gambirananda
9.33.text: What of the holy Brahmanas and devoted, wise sages? Having come to this fleeting, miserable world, worship Me.

9.33.author: Swami Sivananda
9.33.text: How much more easily, then, do Brahmins and devoted royal saints attain the goal? Having come to this impermanent and unhappy world, do thou worship Me.

9.33.author: Shri Purohit Swami
9.33.text: What need is there, then, to mention the holy ministers of God, the devotees, and the saintly rulers? Therefore, do you, born in this changing and miserable world, also worship Me.

9.34.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
9.34.text: Fix your mind on Me; be devoted to Me; offer sacrifice to Me; pay homage to Me. Thus, having your self fixed and Me as your supreme goal, you will certainly attain Me.

9.34.author: Swami Adidevananda
9.34.text: Focus your mind on Me, be My devotee, worship Me. Bow down to Me. Engaging your mind in this manner and regarding Me as the supreme goal, you will come to Me.

9.34.author: Swami Gambirananda
9.34.text: Having your mind fixed on Me, be devoted to Me, sacrifice to Me, and bow down to Me. By concentrating your mind and accepting Me as the supreme goal, you shall surely attain Me, who am thus the Self.

9.34.author: Swami Sivananda
9.34.text: Fix your mind on Me; be devoted to Me; sacrifice to Me; bow down to Me; having thus united your whole self to Me, taking Me as the supreme goal, you will come to Me.

9.34.author: Shri Purohit Swami
9.34.text: Fix your mind on Me, devote yourself to Me, sacrifice for Me, surrender to Me, make Me the object of your aspirations, and you shall assuredly become one with Me, Who am your own Self.
